security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline documentation references, and generic anti-pattern headings. The confirmed issues are three user-directed output file writes that can overwrite local files when scripts are run with --output. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or hidden command execution was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Scripts write to arbitrary output paths supplied by users.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict output files to the target project, refuse existing files by default, or require an explicit overwrite flag.

remediation.issue: Command examples include deployment actions that can change infrastructure if copied directly.
remediation.suggestion: Label destructive or state-changing examples clearly and require users to review targets before running them.

content.value_statement: Teams need repeatable pipelines, infrastructure workflows, and deployment checks. This skill guides CI/CD setup, Terraform planning, deployment automation, and operational reviews.
actual_capabilities: Documents CI/CD pipeline, infrastructure as code, and deployment strategy workflows.
Provides Python helper scripts for target path validation and JSON report output.
Lists common build, test, container, and Kubernetes deployment commands.
Summarizes security, maintainability, performance, and code quality practices.
Links separate reference guides for pipeline, Terraform, and deployment topics.
limitations: Reference guides contain generic examples and need project-specific details.
Helper scripts currently produce placeholder findings instead of deep analysis.
The skill does not deploy infrastructure unless users run commands themselves.
External cloud credentials, Terraform state, and CI provider setup remain user responsibilities.

use_cases.title: Plan CI/CD Improvements
use_cases.description: Review an application workflow and identify pipeline steps for build, test, lint, and deployment gates.

use_cases.title: Prepare Infrastructure Reviews
use_cases.description: Use the Terraform guidance to organize review questions before changing infrastructure modules or environments.

use_cases.title: Create Deployment Checklists
use_cases.description: Turn deployment strategy notes into clear readiness checks for releases, rollbacks, and monitoring handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current CI/CD workflow and list practical improvements for build, test, lint, security, and deployment steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Terraform Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Terraform module structure for this project. Include environments, state handling, variables, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Create Release Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deployment readiness checklist for this service. Cover validation, rollout, rollback, monitoring, and owner responsibilities.

prompt_templates.title: Audit DevOps Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this repository as a DevOps workflow. Identify pipeline gaps, infrastructure risks, deployment risks, and prioritized remediation steps.

output_examples.input: Review a service that builds manually and deploys from a developer laptop.
output: A prioritized CI/CD improvement plan with build, test, and approval stages.
A deployment risk summary covering credentials, rollback, and auditability.
A short list of first changes that reduce manual release risk.

output_examples.input: Prepare an infrastructure review for a new Terraform environment.
output: A review checklist for module boundaries, variables, state, and secrets.
Questions for environment promotion, ownership, and drift management.
Recommended validation steps before applying infrastructure changes.

output_examples.input: Create a release readiness checklist for a Kubernetes service.
output: A readiness checklist for images, manifests, health checks, and monitoring.
Rollback criteria and communication points for release owners.
Post-deployment checks for service health and incident response.

best_practices: Review generated guidance against your real cloud provider, CI system, and deployment permissions.
Run helper scripts only on intended project paths and store output in review folders.
Pair deployment changes with rollback plans, monitoring checks, and clear owners.
anti_patterns: Do not copy deployment commands into production without checking the target context.
Do not store secrets in generated files, logs, examples, or pipeline output.
Do not treat placeholder script findings as a complete security or reliability audit.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy applications automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, scripts, and command examples. Users must choose and run any deployment actions.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does it generate complete Terraform projects?
faq.answer: No. The Terraform script is a lightweight helper and the reference material is generic.

faq.question: What should I review before running examples?
faq.answer: Check the target project, cloud account, cluster context, credentials, and any command that changes infrastructure.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets securely?
faq.answer: It gives general security advice. Secret storage and access controls must be configured in your own tools.

faq.question: Who benefits most from this skill?
faq.answer: DevOps, platform, and engineering teams that need structured reviews for pipelines, infrastructure, and releases.
